description: Schema for an 8 polysemous-key x 4 query-type case set, following the structure documented at https://sushmaakoju.github.io/human-ai-collaborated-ai4science/. This file is a schema only; it is not the original 32-item dataset.
note: Only inconclusive_neutral, equivocation-induced pairs are tested by the hypothesis in this project. Other query types are schema placeholders, not evaluated claims here.
